author: Eyleen Nabyla Alvarenga Niitsuma

steps.title: Normalize gDNA Samples
steps.instruction: Normalize the genomic DNA (gDNA) samples to a concentration of 20ng/μL.

steps.title: Calculate Reaction Requirements
steps.instruction: Determine the total number of reactions needed for each assay, including positive and negative controls, and prepare excess volume to account for pipetting errors.

steps.title: Prepare Reaction Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the reaction mix (Master mix genotyping and TaqMan Assay) for a volume of 10.5 μL per well for a 96-well plate.

substeps.instruction: Vortex the tube briefly to mix components.
Centrifuge the tube briefly to spin down contents and eliminate air bubbles.

steps.title: Dispense Reaction Mix
steps.instruction: Pipette 10.5 μL of the reaction mix into each well of the reaction plate.

steps.title: Add Samples and Water
steps.instruction: Add the normalized gDNA and ultrapure water to the reaction plate using a calibrated, positive-displacement pipettor to avoid contamination.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 2 μL of normalized gDNA (20ng/μL) and 7.5 μL of ultrapure water into each sample well.
Prepare no template controls (NTC) by adding 9.5 μL of ultrapure water (no gDNA).

steps.title: Centrifuge Reaction Plate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the plate briefly to spin down the contents and eliminate air bubbles from the solutions.
